What makes a Top Talent at Ecommpay?

A Top Talent consistently delivers exceptional results, keeps developing their expertise and helps others succeed. Their contribution is visible in business outcomes and in the way they work with colleagues.

Delivers exceptional results

Consistently exceeds agreed performance expectations and takes responsibility for outcomes.

Keeps growing

Builds professional expertise and strengthens the skills needed to work effectively with others.

Makes a business impact

Turns expertise into improvements that matter to the business, such as better client experiences, stronger results or more efficient processes.

Brings others forward

Shares knowledge, collaborates across teams and demonstrates our VICI values in everyday decisions.

The programme combines recognition for what you have achieved with support for your next stage of growth.

Your growth. A stronger team. Greater impact.

Investing in Top Talents benefits the person, their team and Ecommpay.
Here is how those benefits connect.

FOR YOU

Recognition you can build on

Understand your strengths and development opportunities. Create a more focused individual development plan, access support for learning and receive additional rewards for your contribution.

Making a greater impact
FOR MANAGERS

A clearer view of the team’s strengths

Use performance results and colleague feedback to guide development, plan for future roles and responsibilities, and assign work where each person can contribute most. Recognition and development support can also help retain valued colleagues.

Stronger team
FOR ECOMMPAY

Expertise that moves the business forward

Help colleagues apply their strengths to business priorities sooner. Build a culture of high standards, develop expertise for future needs and make talent decisions using shared criteria and evidence.

Business impact

How do you become a Top Talent?

Top Talent recognition is based on sustained performance, colleague feedback and executive calibration.

PERFORMANCE
Above
120%

In each of two consecutive performance cycles — one year in total.

360° FEEDBACK
8+ average score

For soft skills, based on a minimum of five reviews.

EXECUTIVE REVIEW
Calibration session 

The executive team reviews the evidence and validates Top Talent recognition during talent calibration.

To be considered for Top Talent recognition, you need to meet the criteria below. The executive team reviews the evidence against these criteria and makes the final decision during the calibration session.

What we assess during calibration:

Performance
Exceeds KPI targets by ≥120% across two consecutive half-years
Development
Shows measurable progress in both professional expertise and soft skills; actively participates in learning and knowledge sharing
Impact
Creates business value beyond their role: higher revenue, lower costs, faster delivery, better quality, or stronger controls
Behaviours
Receives strong 360° feedback (≥5 reviews, average soft skills score >8) demonstrating collaborative strength and integrity
Mandatory training was completed on time, with no incidents reported.

A package built around you

Being recognised as a Top Talent is about your impact, contribution and potential to grow further. To support your continued development and recognise your contribution, the company offers a package of dedicated opportunities and rewards.

+3 days
More time for yourself

Three additional loyalty days added to your annual leave allowance. Take them as time off during their validity period; unused days expire after one year.

$2,000
Development focused on your growth

A dedicated budget for coaching and learning for each Top Talent. It covers the talent year, from September to September, until the next talent calibration, and is funded by the company’s HR budget.

10%
A one-off Top Talent bonus

A single payment equal to 10% of your monthly salary. The company index is not applied to this bonus.

Personal development, with practical support

Build an enhanced IDP around your priorities. Explore learning, mentoring and other development options with your manager and L&D.

Your contribution,
made visible

Celebrate your work through Top Talent profiles and interviews, so colleagues can learn from your experience.

Set your development goals before requesting external training

Agree your priorities with your manager and record them in your IDP before requesting external learning.

1

Discuss your development

Use a 1:1 with your manager to agree which skills you need and why.

2

Update your IDP

Record the skill, the reason for developing it and the expected result.

3

Submit a Jira request

Request an internal or external learning once your development priority has been agreed with your manager and documented in your IDP.

4

Manager approval

Your manager approves the request in Jira.

5

L&D processes the request

L&D receives and processes the Jira request with your manager’s approval.

Your questions answered

You’ll receive the bonus in the month following the announcement of the results. It is a one-off payment equal to 10% of your monthly salary. The company index is not applied to this bonus.

The $2,000 budget covers the talent year: from September to September, until the next talent calibration. It is funded by the company’s HR budget.

L&D processes your Jira request after your manager approves it. Before submitting a request for external learning in Jira, discuss your development with your manager in a 1:1 and agree your development priorities together.

For example, consider:

  • •Which skills do I need to maintain or strengthen to keep achieving my current goals?
  • •Which new skills will help me work more effectively?
  • •Which skills will help me take a process or project to the next level?
  • •Which knowledge will help me take on new tasks or greater responsibility?

Record these agreements in your individual development plan (IDP), making clear which skill you are developing, why you need it and what result you expect.

Development should make sense for both you and the company. When choosing learning, explain how the knowledge will help you achieve your goals, increase your impact and benefit your team and the business.

Once your development priority is agreed and recorded in your IDP, you can submit your request for external learning in Jira.

Based on objective criteria: performance, 360° feedback and executive calibration.

Typically 1 year, with annual review.

Your Top Talent status is reviewed during the annual calibration and may change based on the results if your performance or behaviour no longer meets the programme criteria. Your status remains unchanged throughout the year, except in cases of serious violations of company policies.

Your Top Talent status gives you priority consideration for promotion opportunities, but it does not guarantee a promotion. Promotion decisions are made separately, based on business needs and established criteria.

Development opportunities are guaranteed. Rewards like bonus and recognition are discretionary.

Apply via the internal mobility platform or through recommendations.

High performance, active development, engagement in opportunities and role modelling our values.
